# old-school: email on a single shared machine {visibility="hidden"}

{{< include /smtp/_old-school.qmd >}}

### terminology

*  SMTP (Simple Mail Transport Protocol)
   *  the standard for sending internet email
*  Mail User Agent (MUA)
   *  a program used to send/receive emails
   *  what humans actually interact with
*  Mail Transfer Agent (MTA)
   *  a program that transfers mail to another program
   *  MUAs are a special case

### things we'll need for "real" email

*  find out right machine to get email to
   *  issue: domain name in address != right machine
*  handling errors
   *  retry sending later
   *  telling user if sending later failed
   *  issue: needs to be done by program running after mail "sent"
*  sending to multiple people
*  reading emails not from a local file
